accent-rule.$description: Thickness of the bars UIDS draws with a pseudo-element: accent rules, underlines and state indicators. Named by value in px. Draw a bar with the pseudo-element's height (its width, for a vertical bar) rather than a border, so every bar is drawn the same way.

4.$description: The button focus and hover bar, and the h6 headline underline.

5.$description: The tab and menu indicators, and the h5 headline underline.

6.$description: The headline underline on h1 to h4, and the gold spacer.

8.$description: The heavy accent rule: stat titles and blockquotes. The blockquote moved here from 10px (D1, 2026-09-21).
